commit.message:
LU-19403 llapi: Move nodemap range and banlist functions

Move nodemap_add_range()/nodemap_del_range(), nodemap_test_nid()
and nodemap_banlist_add()/nodemap_banlist_del() from obdctl to
liblustreapi, adding a binary-NID llapi_nodemap_test_nid_lnet()
variant. All six functions take const char * and reject a NULL
cmd_name.

parse_nid_range() now checks llapi_strscpy()'s return instead of
truncating silently, and frees the nidlist it allocates. The
test_nid functions gain a nodemap_name output parameter instead
of printing it, and return errno directly instead of stashing it
in the global errno.
